settings.heading: SENSOL
settings.subheading: Where strength meets precision, and movement becomes design.

settings.label: 01 — THE PHILOSOPHY
settings.heading: Engineered for those who see movement as a craft
settings.description: Sensol was founded on a simple conviction: fitness equipment should belong in the same conversation as architecture and design. Not as an afterthought in a garage, but as a considered object in a considered space. Every curve, every material, every mechanism is shaped by the belief that how you train is inseparable from where you train.

settings.title: ADAPTIVE RESISTANCE
settings.description: Intelligent resistance that adapts to your body in real-time, providing the perfect challenge at every level.

settings.title: SPATIAL DESIGN
settings.description: Every Sensol is designed as an object of beauty — engineered to belong in your living space, not hidden away.

settings.title: INTELLIGENT MOTION
settings.description: Precision sensors and smart guidance ensure every movement is controlled, measured, and purposeful.

settings.text: MAKE IT EASY · DO IT REAL

settings.label: ENGINEERED MOVEMENT
settings.heading: The first All-in-one smart training reformer
settings.subheading: See how Sensol works in real movement — simple, precise, and intuitive.

settings.label: SENZINE
settings.heading: Distilled ideas, tactile moments
settings.description: Senzine is Sensol's internal publication, distills a single idea — control, resistance, stillness — into a tactile experience, designed to be felt as much as it is read. Released in quiet intervals, each issue carries a fragment of movement, a trace of scent, and a moment of attention.

settings.label: SENSOL APP
settings.heading: Your training companion
settings.description: Control your Sensol reformer from your phone. Track progress, follow guided workouts, and adjust resistance in real-time.
settings.features: Real-time resistance control | 100+ guided workouts | Progress tracking & analytics | Custom training programs
